male.voice_design_instruction: A Korean male broadcaster in his late thirties. A clear, grounded medium-low voice. Speak native standard Seoul Korean. A stern, tense, fast warning delivered at low pitch, like a pilot calling out an alert. No raised pitch.

female.voice_design_instruction: A Korean woman in her thirties with a naturally female, firm and piercing mid-high voice. Speak native standard Seoul Korean. This is a live emergency alert inside a moving car and the driver must react within a second. The delivery is urgent, tense and commanding: fast pace, strong projected voice, high energy, tight breath. Hit 주의 hard and sharply, with only a very short pause after it, then state the rest quickly with crisp articulation and forceful stress, pressing to the end of each sentence. Leave a clear short pause between sentences. Serious and alarmed, never calm, soft, friendly, sing-song or theatrical, and no screaming or crying.
